purpose: Local-only exact-match group definitions for personal text classification. LunaRunes is an optional symbolic language template, not a required taxonomy.
principles: LOC defines the mechanism, not the user's meaning.
The system provides up to eight editable groups plus one fallback group.
All group names, descriptions, keywords and NOR terms are user-defined.
LunaRunes may be used as a symbolic language template, but its group meanings are optional and may be replaced entirely.
NOR excludes the current group only; it is not a global blacklist.
Unmatched text falls back to the reserved fallback group. Its display name and description are editable, but its fallback role is fixed.
All editing, classification, reclassification, import and export are local-first and require no API, account or cloud sync.
